agent.problem: The blank asks for David, but card 1 gives no information from which the baker can reason out the Teacher's father. This asks for wording from a verse the baker has not seen rather than testing meaning they can infer.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: This choice introduces the sun rising and setting in its own question. No earlier story card sets up Ecclesiastes 1:5; the preceding cards concern generations and the earth.

rule.text: The setup for a choice is on a story card. Not every choice card needs its own story card right before it: a choice card can follow another choice card when the setup is already told.

agent.problem: This choice introduces the rivers and the sea without a preceding story card setting up Ecclesiastes 1:7. The preceding story and choice concern the wind, so the rivers have not already been set up.

rule.text: The setup for a choice is on a story card. Not every choice card needs its own story card right before it: a choice card can follow another choice card when the setup is already told.
